provider_secret_handling.mechanism: Generation providers: server process env only — FAL_KEY (~137 reads across api/_lib/site00Evolve, site00ExpressionEngine, site00PageConcept, site00Assts, shared/site00-visual-generation, shared/site00-studio-world-production), ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (~33), OPENAI_API_KEY (~9), XAI_API_KEY (2; SITE00_GROK_API_BASE). No OpenArt API integration exists — OpenArt usage is manual/off-repo (ledgers record OpenArt credits; openartBatchPlanner only plans filenames; productionRouting lists 'openart' as allowed route). No VITE_-prefixed provider keys found (not exposed to browser). Marketing OAuth credentials: AES-256-GCM encrypted rows in site00_provider_secrets keyed by organization_id+provider_key, key from EVOLVE_PROVIDER_SECRET_KEY, refs via secret_ref.
provider_secret_handling.per_project_support: Partial. site00_service_connections is per-project (unique project_id+service_id, secret_ref column) but no generation providers seeded and no secret is ever stored. site00_external_connections has nullable project_id but secrets are org-scoped. No concept of 'client-owned FAL/OpenArt account' or BYOK; grep for byok/funding_mode/production_expense finds nothing.
risks: Single SITE 00-owned key per provider: all client generation spend lands on SITE 00 account with no per-project attribution except optional jsonb cost_metadata
Client connect-service POST lets the client set arbitrary connection_state with no verification (api/site00/client-production.ts:62-76)
founderConfirmedSpend defaults to true in several shared callers -> guard is advisory
Opus cost ledger writes to /tmp (ephemeral) by default
Existing firewall marks PROVIDER_SPEND / providerCostCents as founder-internal — conflicts with client cost transparency unless policy changes
EVOLVE_PROVIDER_SECRET_KEY derived via plain sha256 (no KDF/rotation beyond key_version label)
